title: 构建AI Multi-Agent网站前端
description: 构建网站集成所有API，包含主页、用户中心、API文档页面，实现多Agent协作可视化

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given home page When loading Then neural network background animation displays
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Canvas particle animation with 80 particles and connection lines implemented

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given navigation When clicking Then page switches without reload
acceptance_criteria.evidence: SPA navigation implemented with data-page attribute routing

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given home page Then shows 6 agent cards, stats (6/231/100), feature grid
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Stats section shows 6 Agents, 231 tests, 100 score, 5+ formats; Features grid has 6 cards

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given dashboard page When loaded Then Agent status monitor displays
acceptance_criteria.evidence: agent-monitor grid with 5 agents (PM/Dev/Test/Doc/RAG) with status indicators

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given dashboard page Then chat interface with message history
acceptance_criteria.evidence: chat-messages container with user/assistant message bubbles implemented

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given dashboard page Then knowledge base upload zone with drag-drop
acceptance_criteria.evidence: upload-zone with dragover/drop handlers, fileInput for file selection

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given API page Then displays Chat/RAG/Agents/PM endpoint documentation
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 4 API cards showing POST /api/chat/chat, POST /api/rag/documents, etc.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given API page Then test buttons for each endpoint group
acceptance_criteria.evidence: testChatAPI, testRAGAPI, testAgentsAPI, testPMAPI functions implemented

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given chat send When clicked Then POST to /api/chat/chat
acceptance_criteria.evidence: sendChatMessage function calls fetch with JSON body

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given file upload When dropped Then POST to /api/rag/documents
acceptance_criteria.evidence: handleFiles function uses FormData and fetch POST

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given FastAPI main When running Then serves index.html at /
Given FastAPI main Then CORS enabled for cross-origin requests
